agreements: Gearbox v1 verified baseline and Step009 Heartbeat verified foundation remain preserved; this review changes no formal state and claims no C PASS.
v2 strict_bool now covers inherited authority-sensitive booleans before calling v1; v2.1 also strictly validates secretary freshness, authority conflict and direct verification booleans.
v2 real_experience_claim_allowed now requires C_VERIFIED stage in addition to a verified-kind signal; this is fail-closed hardening but still not verifier provenance.
v2.1 correctly keeps DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND operational-only, while heartbeat/poll/retry/wait/scheduler wake remain zero Experience.
verified_progress_density is currently reason-only and cannot by itself raise gear or create Experience.
v2.1 terminal N/R states bypass anti-thrash numeric parsing and malformed non-Mapping ledger elements are bounded ignores.
The v2.1 contract correctly states speedup is NOT_YET_STATISTICALLY_ESTABLISHED.

disagreements.finding: Material new current-byte defect: v2 rounds the pressure score to four decimal places before applying the 0.45 and 0.70 routing thresholds. A raw pressure slightly below a threshold can round upward and trigger checkpoint/downshift. Presentation precision therefore changes control semantics.
disagreements.required_change: Use the unrounded canonical pressure value for routing and store any rounded value only as presentation/telemetry. Threshold constants remain TEST_REQUIRED.

disagreements.finding: aggregate_experience_events consumes event_id in the transient seen set before proving accepted verified/operational credit; zero-credit/invalid claims can suppress later corrected legitimate bindings in the same batch.
disagreements.required_change: Consume canonical identity only after acceptance; same ID/different binding must be IDENTITY_CONFLICT, exact replay NO_OP.

disagreements.finding: Verifier parsing occurs before duplicate handling, so malformed replay of an already-seen ID can abort the batch instead of becoming bounded replay handling.
disagreements.required_change: Use immutable canonical event envelopes/acceptance registry so exact replay is recognized before mutable-field parsing and malformed rebinding is bounded.

disagreements.finding: Verifier metadata is parsed for every valid-ID mapping before event class is known. WAIT/HEARTBEAT/DURABLE_PROGRESS with malformed verifier metadata can censor later valid evidence although verifier metadata is irrelevant to that class.
disagreements.required_change: Classify canonical EventKind first; parse verifier evidence only for verified kinds and isolate malformed non-atomic records.

disagreements.finding: experience_candidate_delta string-normalizes event_kind but select_gear_v2 later invokes .upper() on the original caller object, allowing non-string inputs to fail inconsistently.
disagreements.required_change: Create one typed EventKind boundary and use only its canonical value through v2/v2.1.

disagreements.finding: v2 uses strip().upper() for current_gear while v2.1 rereads the raw value with upper() only before int parsing; accepted inherited inputs can fail in the overlay.
disagreements.required_change: Normalize once or derive current_gear from canonical runtime state; never reparse raw caller bytes.

disagreements.finding: secretary_signal_fresh and authority_conflict are caller declarations. Strict bool proves type only, not timestamp/TTL, source, revocation, policy, scope or runtime/install binding.
disagreements.required_change: Require trusted SecretarySignalEnvelope and AuthorityDecisionEnvelope with replay-resistant provenance/freshness binding.

disagreements.finding: authority_conflict only neutralizes secretary_level; it does not load or enforce the exact fresh authority decision, so permissive fallback kwargs still control routing.
disagreements.required_change: Project the exact trusted authority snapshot or fail closed.

disagreements.finding: Secretary freshness protects secretary_level only; numeric pressure inputs have no per-field provenance/freshness and can carry stale secretary-derived telemetry into routing.
disagreements.required_change: Bind provenance/freshness to each pressure component; stale secretary-derived components contribute zero while independently trusted telemetry may contribute.

disagreements.finding: recent_shift_rate_ratio remains caller-supplied and thresholded at >=0.50 without canonical numerator/denominator, minimum sample, observation window, uncertainty or enter/exit hysteresis.
disagreements.required_change: Derive from canonical append-only shift history with preregistered support/window/uncertainty and bounded stateful release.

disagreements.finding: Anti-thrash may reduce shift count while delaying a safe required upshift and worsening cycle_completion_latency, verified_closure_per_hour or recovery_latency.
disagreements.required_change: Require paired performance non-regression; fewer shifts alone is not improvement.

disagreements.finding: Verified Experience still depends on event kind, booleans and stage labels; exact evidence hash plus trusted C/independent-verifier identity/receipt are not mandatory.
disagreements.required_change: Require immutable evidence identity and trusted verifier acceptance receipt bound to mission/step/scope, freshness/revocation and installation/workspace identity.

disagreements.finding: event_id dedupe exists only inside one aggregate call. Same evidence under new IDs, cross-run/restart/rollback/poll replay and same-ID rebinding can still be re-credited.
disagreements.required_change: Use a durable rollback-resistant event/evidence-lineage acceptance registry.

disagreements.finding: select_gear_v2_1 recomputes verified and operational deltas directly from caller event fields, bypassing the aggregate ledger and any future durable-ledger repair.
disagreements.required_change: Every nonzero credit must come from one immutable AcceptedExperienceReceipt; receipt-less decision calls emit zero credit.

disagreements.finding: Public v2 still exposes DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND through experience_candidate_delta even though v2.1 classifies them operational-only.
disagreements.required_change: Unify authoritative classification across v2/v2.1; operational progress must not enter an authoritative Experience-labelled field.

disagreements.finding: 5/4/3 verified credits and operational 1 are engineering heuristics, not calibrated capability units.
disagreements.required_change: Never use aggregate credit as capability truth, Trust, Identity, Personality or promotion threshold.

disagreements.finding: No exact-current paired evaluation establishes speedup; commit count, wake count and awake time are invalid proxies.
disagreements.required_change: Use sealed matched workloads and paired/crossover baselines over durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency with frozen metric provenance, exposure/censoring/order, full assigned-workload coverage, uncertainty and verification/risk non-regression.

statistical_risks: Pressure rounding before threshold comparison can change control classification near 0.45/0.70 and create artificial discontinuities unrelated to true raw pressure.
Caller-declared freshness/authority and unbound pressure provenance invalidate causal routing comparisons.
Small-n caller-supplied shift-rate estimates can false-trigger anti-thrash or create threshold chatter.
Anti-thrash may improve gear_shift_rate while degrading cycle/closure/recovery latency.
verified_progress_density becomes self-reinforcing if later connected to routing authority; it must remain observational until independently derived and tested.
Transient event IDs plus same-evidence/new-ID replay, event poisoning and direct credit bypass can inflate or censor longitudinal Experience/progress totals.
Operational-vs-Experience semantics differ between v2 and v2.1, making mixed-consumer metrics incomparable.
5/4/3/1 credits are ordinal engineering heuristics, not capability units.
Speed metrics are numerator/denominator/exposure/order/coverage sensitive and require matched paired/crossover evaluation.
proposed_tests: GB21-PRESSURE-ROUNDING-096: construct raw pressure values immediately below/above 0.45 and 0.70 whose four-decimal presentation values cross or equal the threshold; routing must follow the unrounded canonical value only.
GB21-PRESSURE-MONOTONIC-097: dense sweep around both gates proves no verdict inversion/plateau is introduced by presentation rounding.
GB21-EVENT-ID-POISON-094 + DUPLICATE-PARSE-DOS-095: invalid/zero-credit claims cannot consume identity; exact replay is NO_OP and malformed rebinding is bounded without censoring later evidence.
GB21-IRRELEVANT-VERIFIER-BATCH-091 + OPERATIONAL-VERIFIER-BATCH-092: malformed verifier metadata on zero/operational kinds cannot abort later valid evidence.
GB21-EVENT-KIND-TYPE-089 + CONSISTENCY-090: one canonical typed EventKind is used across v2/v2.1.
GB21-CURRENT-GEAR-NORMALIZATION-093: current_gear canonicalizes once and overlay behavior matches inherited v2.
GB21-STALE-PRESSURE-PROVENANCE-059 + MIXED-SOURCE-060: stale secretary-derived pressure fields are ignored while trusted independent telemetry remains usable.
GB21-AUTHORITY-DECISION-PROJECTION-028: trusted fresh authority=G1/recovery projects G1 despite permissive fallback kwargs.
GB21-SHIFT-RATE-PROVENANCE-017 + SHIFT-SMALL-N-004 + ANTI-THRASH-CHATTER-040 + RELEASE-041: canonical shift history, adequate support, uncertainty and stateful release are required.
GB21-PROGRESS-DENSITY-FORGE-007: verified_progress_density=1 alone has zero routing/Experience/promotion/authority effect.
GB21-CROSS-RUN-SAME-ID-018 + ROLLBACK-LEDGER-019 + POLL-REPLAY-020 + EVENT-REBIND-021: durable exactly-once and lineage semantics survive restart/rollback/polling.
GB21-VERIFIER-EVIDENCE-011: verified kind without exact evidence hash plus trusted C/independent-verifier receipt gets zero authoritative credit.
GB21-DIRECT-CREDIT-BYPASS-022 + OPERATIONAL-CREDIT-BYPASS-024: every nonzero credit is receipt-bound.
GB21-CREDIT-SCORE-014: equal aggregate scores from different event mixes cannot imply equivalent capability or promotion.

GB21-PAIRED-SPEED-015 + WAKE-DENOMINATOR-FREEZE-030 + TIME-WINDOW-FREEZE-032 + ORDER-CROSSOVER-036 + ITT-WORKLOAD-COVERAGE-038: speedup requires matched paired/crossover evidence with frozen metric provenance and non-regression.

requirements: Exact-current v1+v2+v2.1 same-runner regression PASS on current six blobs without weakening v1 baseline.
Pressure routing uses unrounded canonical values; rounding is presentation-only and threshold constants remain TEST_REQUIRED.
Secretary freshness and authority decisions are trusted-envelope bound; stale/conflicting secretary data, including numeric pressure fields, has zero routing authority.
recent_shift_rate_ratio is canonically derived with preregistered sample/window/uncertainty and bounded anti-thrash release; paired metrics show no cycle/closure/recovery regression.
verified_progress_density remains observational unless independently derived and adversarially proven non-self-reinforcing.
Durable rollback-resistant event/evidence acceptance registry provides exact replay NO_OP, same-evidence/new-ID lineage dedupe and same-ID/different-binding IDENTITY_CONFLICT.
Verified Experience requires exact evidence hash plus trusted C/independent-verifier receipt; operational progress remains separate and receipt-bound.
v2/v2.1 authoritative semantics are unified so DURABLE_PROGRESS/ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND never become verified Experience.
5/4/3/1 weights remain heuristic-only and cannot drive capability/Trust/Identity/Personality promotion.

Speedup is established only with matched sealed paired/crossover evidence using durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency; commit/wake/awake-time proxies are forbidden.
Independent Spirit adversarial review and fresh Navigator synthesis have zero unresolved release vetoes before any formal A->B->C route.
